audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer is built on 'Personal Space (Fear)' — the focus, the loading screen, the cooldowns block, the key-interactions report and every trade rule. Personal Space is Vex's W and per Riot's text it does one thing: 'Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.' There is no fear on it. The fear belongs to Doom 'n Gloom, the passive: 'Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes.'
audit.why: This is the same class of error as calling Cassiopeia's grounding a Q effect. A player watching her W for the fear watches the wrong ability and steps up on the wrong timer — the tell is whether the passive is charged, and there is no W cooldown to count for it.
audit.corrected: focus.text, loading, winCon, report[1].t, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d, report[9].t and report[3].t now attribute the fear to Doom 'n Gloom and describe Personal Space as the 16s shield it is.
sources: brief enemyKit W text 'Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies', cd 16/15/14/13/12

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] and content early both said 'you outrange her'. Mistral Bolt is 1200 range; Command: Attack is 815.
audit.why: She out-ranges you by a long way. The early edge is that she has one cast and no charged fear yet, not range.
audit.corrected: whys[0], early, tldr, breakdown.early and phases[0/1].why re-grounded on cast count and passive charge, with the 1200-vs-815 gap stated plainly.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes claimed 'level 6 doubles your lane presence' — level 6 is HERS on this matchup, per the content layer and the packet — and 'Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar' is a magnitude with no source.
audit.why: Shadow Surge is 140s at rank 1 but marks from 2000 units and recasts into a dash, and it resets. That is the swing at 6.
audit.corrected: Spike line, breakdown.mid and phases[4].why rewritten around Shadow Surge's range and reset.
sources: brief enemyKit R cd 140/120/100, range 2000/2500/3000, text

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no cooldown number, and dosFull[2].d offered a 'fifteen-second invitation' for an ability that has no fixed fear cooldown at all.
audit.why: There is no number to give for the passive's charge; the honest advice is to watch the charge, and the real numbers belong to Mistral Bolt 8s, Personal Space 16s, Looming Darkness 12s and Shadow Surge 140s.
audit.corrected: Those four cooldowns now appear in breakdown.cooldowns; dosFull[2].d now says take the window before it recharges rather than inventing a duration.
sources: brief enemyKit cooldowns Q 8/7/6/5/4, W 16/15/14/13/12, E 12, R 140/120/100

notes: Biggest finding in my slice: the entire full layer named the wrong ability for Vex's fear. 'Personal Space (Fear)' was the focus, the loading line, the cooldowns block, the key-interactions report and the all-in windows — but Personal Space is the W and Riot's text gives it only a shield and nearby damage. The fear is Doom 'n Gloom, the passive, which empowers her NEXT basic ability. Every one of those fields was rewritten to name the passive. spikes[0].text also called Looming Darkness a 'fear-detonate'; corrected to name the passive as the fear source. Second correction: two fields claimed you out-range Vex — Mistral Bolt is 1200 to your 815, so it was backwards. Pronouns: Vex is female and the full layer used he/his throughout; fixed including the dosFull and dontsFull titles. Chart: phases[0], phases[1] and phases[4] contradicted content win[0/1/4]; win[] matched the packet levelChart and the whys, so those three sides were moved and their whys rewritten in one atomic group. Ratings untouched. Deliberately NOT written: whether Doom 'n Gloom's fear can be cleansed or reduced by tenacity, and whether Orianna's ball counts as a 'nearby dash' for her passive mark — neither is answerable from the kits. Left templated but not grounded: report[6].t, report[7].t and report[12].t are Orianna-generic but contain nothing false.
